notes.title: Version 4.0.0 is now Available
notes.content:
The following changes have been made to the Jetlad in version 4.0.0:

Achievements
- Steam Achievements for Jetlad are now live.

Controller
- Users can now play with a controller.
   * Steam Controller Settings must be disabled before launching game 

Full Screen
- The game now runs in full screen mode.

Pause
- Users can now pause during a level.

notes.title: Jetlad v3.0 Available Now!
notes.content:
The game has been updated to reduce difficulty and improve some visuals.

This update includes the following changes:

 Jetlad now had three lives for each level instead of one.

 Each level includes three checkpoints and a starting point.

 Levels have been adapted to include checkpoints and to remove any scenarios that were considered unfair.

 Updated HUD. 

 Updated Fuel Box sprite.
